narr: A weak disturbance moving northward through central Arizona interacted with monsoon moisture already in place to initiate showers and thunderstorms across the area. The timing of peak heating and the arrival of the disturbance created heavy rain in the Page, Arizona area.
ev: Flash flooding was reported in X Canyon, Antelope Canyon, and Lower Antelope Canyon (all the same drainage). Standing water remained in Lower Antelope Canyon on July 6.
lsr: CORRECTS PREVIOUS FLASH FLOOD REPORT FROM LOWER ANTELOPE CANYON. FLASH FLOODING REPORTED IN LOWER ANTELOPE CANYON, UPPER ANTELOPE CANYON AND AT CANYON X (FURTHER UP THE DRAINAGE). STANDING WATER STIL
